card.name: Particles after verbs like keep, concerned
card.fires_on: The small words "up" or "with" right after a verb or adjective such as keep, kept, team, follow, concerned or pleased. It appears in general web prose, not drug text.

modes.label: up after verb
modes.description: The word "up" completing a phrasal verb like keep up, team up or follow up.
modes.example: Join our mailing list to keep<< up>>-to-date with our latest news and events

modes.label: with after concerned/pleased
modes.description: The word "with" following an adjective of concern or feeling, before the thing concerned.
modes.example: Occupational therapy is a health profession concerned<< with>> promoting health and well-being through occupation.
